question: Should `messages.groupChat.historyLimit: 0` become accepted upgrade behavior that disables group-chat history, matching docs and sibling history-limit schemas?
rationale: The patch is technically focused, but it changes upgrade behavior because zero-valued configs that were previously rejected will start taking effect.

options.title: Accept documented zero semantics
options.body: Proceed with this PR if maintainers agree the existing docs and sibling schema behavior should apply to the global group-chat key on upgrade.

options.title: Ask for one fresh upgrade smoke
options.body: Request current-head proof covering direct config load, runtime schema lookup, and `config.patch` if maintainers want extra upgrade confidence before merge.

options.title: Pause zero support
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers decide the global group-chat key should continue rejecting zero despite the current docs and sibling schemas.

recommendation.title: Accept documented zero semantics
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR if maintainers agree the existing docs and sibling schema behavior should apply to the global group-chat key on upgrade.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this handle to both the schema file and Gateway config handler path affected by the compatibility decision.
